body:
It indeed has wrong return type in the core (was added like that in #83757):
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/551ce8d47feda9c81c870314745366b24957624b/scene/main/node.cpp#L3450

C# version is generated according to the core (thus returning `Godot.Collections.Array<System.Int32>`), no issue there.

Note that in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/83757#issuecomment-1774053706 I've suggested `Array[int] get_orphan_nodes()` signature. However, I was using GDScript syntax there, where `int` is 64-bit signed integer (GDScript has no unsigned type). Nevertheless this might have led to the wrong type in the core.

AFAICT the fix is as simple as changing `Node::get_orphan_node_ids` to return `TypedArray<ObjectID>`. Not sure if anything would need to be added for the C# bindings compatibility. cc @raulsntos

> AFAICT the fix is as simple as changing `Node::get_orphan_node_ids` to return `TypedArray<ObjectID>`. Not sure if anything would need to be added for the C# bindings compatibility.

Changing the return type breaks binary compatibility for the C# bindings, but maybe it's acceptable to break compatibility here since this method was only added in 4.5 and may not be used much yet.
